author: Marlon Chaviano
name: raycast-extension
title: Raycast extension
description: A Raycast extension with React and TypeScript: a command with a searchable list, using the official components and utilities.

base.command: mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && printf '%s\n' '{"name": "{{name}}", "version": "0.1.0", "private": true, "title": "{{name}}", "description": "", "icon": "extension-icon.png", "author": "tu-usuario", "license": "MIT", "categories": ["Productivity"], "commands": [{"name": "index", "title": "Search", "description": "Search the list", "mode": "view"}]}' > package.json

setupTasks: Raycast: add a 512×512 icon at `assets/extension-icon.png` and put your Raycast username in `author` before `npm run dev`.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each Raycast command is a file in `src/` declared in `commands` in `package.json` (`name` = file name).
- Use `@raycast/api` components (`List`, `Detail`, `Form`, `ActionPanel`) and `@raycast/utils` hooks (`useFetch`, `useCachedPromise`); there's no DOM or CSS.
- Develop with `npm run dev` (opens the command in Raycast with reloading).
- Before finishing: `npm run check` and `npm run lint`.
